distanceSource: Placed in M33 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 860,254 pc (src/objects/m33-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 859,014 pc from the Local Volume Database v1.1.1 (Pace 2025), inclination 54 deg, line of nodes 22.5 deg). (2023), ApJ 951, 118, abstract: modulus 24.622 +/- 0.03 mag, 840 kpc; it places the galaxy, not a star within it (https://doi.org/10.33232/001c.144859): 860254 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star
radiusSource: Radius 100.3 +/- 16.7 solar radii from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, period relations for Galactic fundamental-mode Cepheids applied to this star's period, 18.79 d in Breuval et al.
